scope: Independent local final review of the immutable release package, editorial audit, source URLs, placement anchors, inherited notes, target reviewed connections and publishing pipeline.
verifiedDesign: Exact immutable note preimages and after-file hashes prevent applying onto a changed baseline.
Author-body hashing excludes only footnotes; reverse reconstruction proves all unreviewed notes and fields retain their exact prior structure.
New quotation notes have one English paragraph, a bold exact source link, original Hebrew evidence, no explanatory paragraphs, and stable inherited IDs/numbers on replacements.
The quotation publication stage runs after historical edition checks and before Beit Toldos/Dover baseline capture; final ZIP/MCP checks therefore protect the new Shabbos edition.
Browser assertions check each marker against the actual Hebrew DOM prefix, each full quotation box, one source link, no duplicate English-side marker, and both desktop/mobile widths.
Only quotationOnly or existing Dover notes receive newly indexed note-source anchors in the MCP build.
hardeningResolved: The publisher now enforces supported source URLs, internal ref/URL equality, and bounded numeric Hebrew/English offsets.
